findings.location: crates/ryo/crates/execution/src/domain/completion/service.rs:98 (file_kind = File|Node), :140-160 (file_keyed), Antijoin and OrderedMatch arms below
findings.failure: The fix treats any Node-typed key of the missing operand as anchoring the matched rows of the other operand to the missing file, on the stated assumption that 'its nodes lie in that file'. Nothing enforces that for step outputs: S = join(A rows of file f, B rows of file g on name) keeps (A.file, B.node); join(S, M) on B.node with M missing file g marks only g partial while the f rows of S lose the matches M's g rows would supply, so f is answered Complete. 'Resolve foreign File/Node partition lineage' is the Phase 1 open item itself (README:25).
findings.required_enforcement: Carry per-column file lineage (or restrict file_keyed to a File column / a base-relation Node column whose catalog declares same-file nodes) and add a negative fixture with a foreign node column that must stay Partial for the foreign file.
